title: CoRTeC: A Differentially Private Release for Synthetic Tabular Data, Decodable by Any Generator
abstract: arXiv:2611.06342v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The records that could train the most useful models, such as a hospital's patient files, are often the ones an institution cannot share. We propose CoRTeC, a method that releases synthetic versions of such records under differential privacy. Differential privacy places a proven limit on what the synthetic data can reveal about any person, and in particular on membership inference. CoRTeC spends the privacy budget once, on a small file of noisy counts designed for training a classifier. For each group of records, the file gives the group's size, its balance of outcomes, a histogram of every column for each outcome and the outcome rate in each of several non-overlapping cells. A reviewer can check every number before the file leaves the institution. Anyone can then turn the counts into synthetic rows, as often as they like and at no further privacy cost. translated_title: CoRTeC：一种可由任意生成器解码的差分隐私合成表格数据发布方法
translated_abstract: 那些最能用于训练有价值模型的数据记录，例如医院的病历档案，往往恰恰是机构无法对外共享的数据。我们提出了CoRTeC，一种在差分隐私保护下发布此类记录合成版本的方法。差分隐私对合成数据可能泄露的关于任何个人的信息量提供了可证明的界限，尤其能够防范成员推断攻击。CoRTeC只花费一次隐私预算，用于生成一个专为训练分类器而设计的小型含噪计数文件。对于每组记录，该文件给出了该组的规模、其结果分布的均衡情况、每种结果下每一列的直方图，以及若干互不重叠的单元格中每一格的结果率。审核人员可以在文件离开机构之前逐一核查其中的每个数字。此后，任何人都可以将这些计数转换为合成数据行，并且可以根据需要任意多次进行，而不会产生额外的隐私成本。最大熵解码器可以在完全不使用语言模型的情况下完成这一转换，其他各类生成器也同样可以做到。
tldr: CoRTeC通过一次性发布一组经过差分隐私保护的含噪统计计数文件，使任何人都能用最大熵解码器或语言模型等任意生成器、以零额外隐私成本反复生成可防成员推断攻击的合成表格数据。
en_tdlr: CoRTeC releases a small file of noisy counts once under differential privacy, enabling anyone to decode privacy-preserving synthetic tabular data with any generator—from maximum-entropy decoders to language models—at no additional privacy cost.
